errors.description: Set consistency: the three collar-stand siblings were shot on different cloth and different underlayers (notch = charcoal over bare skin, peak = navy over a navy shirt, shawl = navy over bare skin) despite a MATCHED SET LOCK in each prompt. This one is the notch member.
errors.expected: identical cloth, underlayer, subject distance and framing across notch/peak/shawl
errors.correction: On any re-shoot, fix one cloth and one underlayer across all three members.

notes: Notch reads correctly: squared collar-leaf point, blunt square-cut lapel corner, an open wedge gap between them, deep V, one button at the base. Distinguishable at a glance from both siblings, which is the bar for a SHAPE family - members differ by shape rather than by a measurement, so no blind-ordering ladder gate applies.
